same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

selected_facts.text_zh: 执行VTBS 20R RNP进近需要注意。ATKIN之后转5边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165，intercept final course 20R，report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP的五边，而不是许可RNP进近，注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP进近不允许执行“高截获”程序。02L进近常指挥保持3边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM或ABVER，在引入02LRNP进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM如果没有选择VIA计划上看不到BATEM点。
selected_facts.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches. During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

selected_facts.text_zh: 02L落地后使用F W跑道外等，使用W穿越跑道Straight ahead D4换频121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线例如S123 D滑行G前等，继续滑行T18或T19进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无指令，02L落地后应延F、W、02R外等，20R落地后应延F、Z、20L外等。
selected_facts.text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. same_phase_english_candidates.text: Special complex procedures: During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine startcommand, after which itwill resume aircraft traction. The crew must carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.
Single-engine taxiing is not recommended when the taxi route is expected to include asphalt pavement.
In case of communication failure, follow the airchart or airport regulations.
The airspace is abnormally busy with short intervals, and the waiting time may differ from standard waiting periods. Please verify this.

Three runways will be operational: The original 01R/19L runway will be renamed 01/19, and the former 01L/19R runway will be renamed 02R/20L. The third runway, 02L/20R, will serve as a non-precision approach runway, allowing the use of the RNP approach procedure.
South approach and departure: 19 for takeoff and landing, 20L for takeoff, 20R for landing. North approach and departure: 01 for takeoff and landing, 02R for takeoff, 02L for landing.
Pavement characteristics: If the skidway is uneven and the vehicle stillcannot be moved out when the N1-50% threshold isreached, a tow truck is required.
Meteorological characteristics: Frequent thunderstorms in summer

Navigation facilities: The SVB station has been inactive for an extended period due to relocation, resulting in the absence of VOR approach procedures. The blind landing range finder exhibits positional inaccuracies relative to the runway end, which may cause operational instability.
Frequent military exercises often involve route changes. Please check against the flight plan.
During RNP approach procedures at this airport, ATC instructions may differ from the procedure design logic. Compliance with company FOIB.

same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

aggregate_selected_facts.text_zh: 执行VTBS 20R RNP进近需要注意。ATKIN之后转5边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165，intercept final course 20R，report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP的五边，而不是许可RNP进近，注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP进近不允许执行“高截获”程序。02L进近常指挥保持3边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM或ABVER，在引入02LRNP进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM如果没有选择VIA计划上看不到BATEM点。
aggregate_selected_facts.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches. During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

same_phase_english_candidates.text: No need to recite PDC

The departure taxiway is designated as "YELLOW", while the arrival taxiway is "GREEN". Pilots must familiarize themselves with the specific taxiway number before each run, as itcorresponds to the standard taxiway for both departure and arrival. During approach preparation, they should review the taxiway chart in advance. If the crew needs to deviate from the runway, they must promptly confirm the turn direction with air traffic control.
Typically, aircraft take off from 01R/19L or 02L/20R, and land from 01L/20R or 02L/20R.
When the lead vehicle approaches, the ground commander acts as its driver. Upon reaching the target position, the commander must control the speed and guide the driver to disembark.
The company requires single-engine taxiing for aircraft landing in Guangzhou, with particular attention to turning speed when approaching shorter and narrower aprons, such as those on the J3 apron.

The green password for the covered bridge is 202510 (marked with a green√). For international flights entering through boarding gates, please call the access control phone (marked beside the gate) to open the door.

At Guangzhou O2 R, the M taxiway is operational while the T64 taxiway lacks signage, with only ground taxiway markers visible. The T64 sign is actually positioned behind the taxiway, which may cause confusion.

same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

selected_facts.text_zh: 执行VTBS 20R RNP进近需要注意。ATKIN之后转5边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165，intercept final course 20R，report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP的五边，而不是许可RNP进近，注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP进近不允许执行“高截获”程序。02L进近常指挥保持3边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM或ABVER，在引入02LRNP进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM如果没有选择VIA计划上看不到BATEM点。
selected_facts.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches. During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

selected_facts.text_zh: 02L落地后使用F W跑道外等，使用W穿越跑道Straight ahead D4换频121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线例如S123 D滑行G前等，继续滑行T18或T19进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无指令，02L落地后应延F、W、02R外等，20R落地后应延F、Z、20L外等。
selected_facts.text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

selected_facts.text_en: When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

same_phase_english_candidates.text: No need to recite PDC

The departure taxiway is designated as "YELLOW", while the arrival taxiway is "GREEN". Pilots must familiarize themselves with the specific taxiway number before each run, as itcorresponds to the standard taxiway for both departure and arrival. During approach preparation, they should review the taxiway chart in advance. If the crew needs to deviate from the runway, they must promptly confirm the turn direction with air traffic control.
Typically, aircraft take off from 01R/19L or 02L/20R, and land from 01L/20R or 02L/20R.
When the lead vehicle approaches, the ground commander acts as its driver. Upon reaching the target position, the commander must control the speed and guide the driver to disembark.
The company requires single-engine taxiing for aircraft landing in Guangzhou, with particular attention to turning speed when approaching shorter and narrower aprons, such as those on the J3 apron.

The green password for the covered bridge is 202510 (marked with a green√). For international flights entering through boarding gates, please call the access control phone (marked beside the gate) to open the door.

At Guangzhou O2 R, the M taxiway is operational while the T64 taxiway lacks signage, with only ground taxiway markers visible. The T64 sign is actually positioned behind the taxiway, which may cause confusion.

same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

fact_evidence.selected_chinese_text: 执行VTBS 20R RNP进近需要注意。ATKIN之后转5边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165，intercept final course 20R，report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP的五边，而不是许可RNP进近，注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP进近不允许执行“高截获”程序。02L进近常指挥保持3边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM或ABVER，在引入02LRNP进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM如果没有选择VIA计划上看不到BATEM点。

source_original_texts: 进场：执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。
进场：02L进近 常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后 指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提 示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点。

same_phase_english_candidates.text: Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

aggregate_selected_facts.text_zh: 执行VTBS 20R RNP进近需要注意。ATKIN之后转5边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165，intercept final course 20R，report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP的五边，而不是许可RNP进近，注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP进近不允许执行“高截获”程序。02L进近常指挥保持3边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM或ABVER，在引入02LRNP进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM如果没有选择VIA计划上看不到BATEM点。
aggregate_selected_facts.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches. During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

             Suvarnabhumi       Airport,   Bangkok     (BKK/VTBS)



                                                        Updated   on 2026.8.10
                                     Responsibility  Division:  Ninth  Division

1、Typical     unsafe  event
           1.Affected   by  ground   temperature,   prone  to low  approach
     profiles, long  landing  distances,  etc. Crew   attention  required.
      II. Core  Threats
    1.Special   complex   procedures:
           During  the  deployment    of some   aircraft positions,  the
     system   may  temporarily   halt to issue  an engine   startcommand,
     after which   itwill resume   aircraft traction. The   crew  must

Special complex procedures: During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine startcommand, after which itwill resume aircraft traction. The crew must carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.
Single-engine taxiing is not recommended when the taxi route is expected to include asphalt pavement.
In case of communication failure, follow the airchart or airport regulations.
The airspace is abnormally busy with short intervals, and the waiting time may differ from standard waiting periods. Please verify this.

Three runways will be operational: The original 01R/19L runway will be renamed 01/19, and the former 01L/19R runway will be renamed 02R/20L. The third runway, 02L/20R, will serve as a non-precision approach runway, allowing the use of the RNP approach procedure.
South approach and departure: 19 for takeoff and landing, 20L for takeoff, 20R for landing. North approach and departure: 01 for takeoff and landing, 02R for takeoff, 02L for landing.
Pavement characteristics: If the skidway is uneven and the vehicle stillcannot be moved out when the N1-50% threshold isreached, a tow truck is required.
Meteorological characteristics: Frequent thunderstorms in summer

Navigation facilities: The SVB station has been inactive for an extended period due to relocation, resulting in the absence of VOR approach procedures. The blind landing range finder exhibits positional inaccuracies relative to the runway end, which may cause operational instability.
Frequent military exercises often involve route changes. Please check against the flight plan.
During RNP approach procedures at this airport, ATC instructions may differ from the procedure design logic. Compliance with company FOIB.

On-site/Dispatch Frequency: BANGKOKBLUEPORT (BANG-KOKBLUEPORT), Frequency 129.050. Should our crew members have any inquiries at Suvarnabhumi Airport—such as requests for TOBT/TSAT/landing slot information, flight planning assistance, or special requests—please contact them via this frequency.

During ground operations, ensure the Mode S transponder is operational and activated (e.g.,not in STAND-BY or OFF position). Set the designated Mode A code (for departing aircraft, use the code from the received clearance; forarriving aircraft,maintain the original code until fully parked in the apron).

To prevent potential interference, TCAS should remain activated for departing aircraft until receiving the go-to or go-around command, and deactivated for arriving aircraft until the aircraft has left the runway.
Note that H6 and H3, as well as H5 and H2, are on the same taxiway.

During refueling, passengers must input their name's pinyin on the electronic tablet as a signature. Suvarnabhumi Airport prohibits boarding during refueling. Ifboarding is necessary, notify the airport in advance to prepare fire trucks. For details, contact Spring Airlines Maintenance. The code for the jet bridge is 2580#.
Noise reduction procedures are in effect. The use of heavy reverse thrust is prohibited between 1900 and 2300 UTC unless it compromises flight safety.

At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.
Common procedures: RNAV
To minimize runway time, pilots must ensure they can begin taxiing immediately upon receiving the takeoff clearance.
Automatic wave separation from the ground 119.25.

When using the 20L runway for takeoff, there is a high risk of taxiing errors due to the proximity of E1 and E2 runways, and the E taxiway's extension to the cargo apron. Crew members must exercise caution.
Runway 01 will use B12 for departure.
For departure on the 19th, the Selka1J is typically used. After takeoff, the airtraffic controller may cancel the restricted direct flight to Selka and then direct a direct flightto SAV.

For ZUTF-VTBS, if the post-SAGAG flight route changes, the MCDU and flight plan must be updated. After SAGAG, Vientiane will direct the direct flightto TOMIP. After the route point NAN, Bangkok control will direct the direct flight to TL.

During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. The crew should be thoroughly familiar with the technical notice, maintain awareness of the minimum safe altitude throughout the flight, and follow the technical notice for handling.
Common procedures: RNAV entry
The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is5nm, and itmay be reduced to 3nm inBKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.

页码：1563

                  GUANGZHOU           BAIYUN      (ZGGG-CAN)
                                                            Updated  on2026.7.13
                                         ResponsibilityDivision: Seventh Division

I. Typical   Safety   Incidents
1. The   airport  has  experienced     incidents   including   bird  strikes,
wind   shear,  and  wrong    takeoff   events.  Crew    members     are
advised   to  remain   vigilant  in identifying    these  risks.
II. Core   Threats
     1. Command      Characteristics:
     (1) The  departure   taxiway   ismarked    as "YELLOW",       and  the
     arrival taxiway   is marked   as "GREEN".
     (2) In case  of discrepancy    between   the flight plan's  re-flight
     altitude and  the air traffic control  command,     the latter shall
     prevail.
     2. Pavement    characteristics:
     (1) After  landing  at 01L,  the taxiway   from   E J23  to J14  features
     a steep  incline. We   recommend     performing    a single-engine   taxi
     after this section.
     3. Meteorological    characteristics:  From   late spring  to summer,
     thunderstorms    are frequent,   with severe   thunderstorms    often
     accompanied     by  low-level  wind   shear. During   summer    and
     autumn,   typhoons   exert  influence,  bringing   widespread    strong
     winds,  heavy   rainfall, and  thunderstorms.
     4. Other  threats:
     (1) The  airport  ishighly  busy   with  multiple  adjacent  airports,
     requiring  strict compliance    with  air trafficcontrol  directives  to
     prevent  conflicts.
     (2) Adjust  the  single-shot  acceleration   altitude according    to the
     fly Smart  modification.
     (3) The  new   procedure   involves   adjustments   to multiple
     programs    and name   changes,   with  height  restrictions  requiring
     modifications.   Please  refer  to the air chart for MCDU      data
     verification.
     (4) New   airport  runways   pose  risks of  misidentification,
     misdirection,   or land  to wrong   way.  Crews   must   stay vigilant,
     enforce  standardized    announcements     and  cross-checking
     procedures,   especially  during   low  visibility, rain, or night
     operations,  to prevent   runway   confusion.


版本：20260924         修订日期：2026.09.24                                       页码：1563
页码：1564


III. Operational    Characteristics
  (1)  Ground:
     1.On-site/dispatch    frequency:   131.5
     2. Command     Characteristics:
     (1) No  need  to recite PDC
     (2) The  departure   taxiway  is designated   as "YELLOW",       while
     the arrival taxiway   is "GREEN".     Pilots must   familiarize
     themselves   with  the specific  taxiway   number   before  each  run,  as
     itcorresponds    to the standard  taxiway   for both  departure   and
     arrival. During   approach   preparation,  they  should  review   the
     taxiway   chart in advance.   If the crew  needs  to deviate  from   the
     runway,   they  must  promptly   confirm   the turn  direction with  air
     traffic control.
     (3) Typically,  aircraft take  off from  01R/19L    or 02L/20R,    and
     land from   01L/20R    or 02L/20R.
     4. Precautions:
     (1) When   the  lead vehicle  approaches,    the ground   commander
     acts as its driver. Upon   reaching   the target position,  the
     commander     must  control  the speed   and  guide  the driver  to
     disembark.
     (2) The  company    requires  single-engine    taxiing for aircraft
     landing  in Guangzhou,     with  particular attention  to turning  speed
     when   approaching    shorter and  narrower   aprons,  such  as  those on
     the J3 apron.
     (3) The  green  password    for the covered   bridge  is 202510
     (marked   with  a green√).   For international   flights entering
     through  boarding   gates,  please  call the access  control  phone
     (marked   beside  the gate)  to open  the door.

     (4) At Guangzhou     O2   R, the M   taxiway  is operational   while  the
     T64  taxiway   lacks  signage,  with  only ground   taxiway   markers
     visible. The  T64  sign  is actually positioned   behind   the taxiway,
     which   may  cause  confusion.
     5. Ice removal/anti-icing    capability:  None
  (II) Exit:
     1. Command     Characteristics:

页码：1565

     (1) The  aircraft automatically   disengages   from   the wave   contact
     after leaving  the ground   and  approaches,   with  the specific
     frequency   provided   by the  airtraffic control.
     (2) Ifthe  SID  has speed   restrictions, you  may  apply  to cancel
     them;  otherwise,  you  must   comply.
     (3) Departing   from  Lanzhou    may   be directed  to fly directly to
     P268  or P118,   then join  the X64  temporary    route to QP.
     Departing   from  Southeast   Asia  may   be directed  to fly directly to
     P50,  then join the  X66  temporary    route to BIGRO.
     3. Precautions:
     For early  departure  flights, select the  departure  runway   based   on
     real-time  airtraffic updates   and clearance   requirements.
  (3) Navigation    routes:
     1. The  W19   route  segment   MASGU-MABAG-OGABI-
     NOMAR      will be  adjusted  to MASGU-UPMIP-ATKAV-
     OBLAP-NOMAR          for flights landing   in Guangzhou     and those
     flying over  the Pearl  River  Delta  region  bound   for East China.
     2. The  Guangzhou-Langman        border   crossing  isdesignated   as
     ASSAD.
     3. The  flight from  Guangzhou     to Ningbo   will firstjoin  the
     XEBUL     air route, then  transfer to the H25   route to VETIB.    After
     VETIB,    itwill switch  to the W155    route  to TEBON,     then rejoin
     the A470   and  B221   routes via  DST   before  returning  to the
     original route.  During  the  preparation  phase,  passengers   should
     mentally  prepare   for potential last-minute   air trafficcontrol
     changes   to avoid  panic.
  (4) Entry:
     1. Command     Characteristics:
     (1) After  entering  the field,radar  guidance   will be  used  to
     calculate  the altitude-to-range   ratio.
     (2) The  vessel  shall maintain  a speed   of 180  to 8 knots, ensuring
     sufficient spacing   to avoid  insufficient intervals.
     3. Precautions:
     (1) After  the Guangzhou     01L  aircraft landed,  when   directing  the
     GREEN     1 aircraft, the E left-turn  signal for T3  was  absent  on  the
     leftside, and  no  ground   indicator showed    the approach   to T3.
     Only  an  approach   to T4  was  indicated,  with a signal  light at T4,
     which  could  easily  cause  confusion.
(5) Special  operational   requirements:
     1. Noise  reduction  procedure:   Refer  to Rule   2.21.2.

     2. PBN   single-engine   departure   procedures   for Runways     01L/R
     、02L/R     and  RWY03     are applicable.  The   JEPPESEN      chart does
     not include  single-engine    departure  procedures;   Foreign   pilots
     should  refer to the EFB   chart.
     3. Pressure  relief procedure:   Refer  to EFB   for details.
     4. Radio  failure procedure:   Refer   to Section  2.22.5  of the airport

     4.  Arrival,    Approach       and   Landing     Phase


     4.1.  For  BK   arrival:during   north-bound    operations,  RWY    35L  (western  runway)   is

           normally   assigned;  during  south-bound    operations,  RWY    16L   (eastern runway)

4.2.   Multiple   arrival  procedures    are  in  use,  with  ad-hoc    amendments      possible.

       Direct-to  clearances  are  common    during  off-peak   periods. Maintain   contingency
       plans.
4.3.   Multiple  TA/RA    alerts have  been   recorded  during  south-bound     approaches   into

       Pudong.   Prepare  contingency    measures   during  approach   preparation  and  execute
       memory-item     procedures   per  aircraft manual.

4.4.   For  RWY     17R   / 35L,  ATC    may   assign  short  base-leg   vectors   or issue  ILS
       clearance   at a late stage.  Anticipate   such  scenarios,  conduct   proactive   energy
       management,     maintain   active  communication     and  accept  ATC   radar  vectors  as

       required.  When   performing    “glideslope   capture  from  above”   procedure,   strictly
       comply   with  SOP.  If stable-approach    criteriacannot  be  satisfied, execute  missed

       approach   or discontinued   approach   without  hesitation.
4.5.   For  RWY     34R   approach,   tall obstacles   exist slightly  right-of-track   between
       waypoints   PD083    and  PD084.   Over-flying    ator  maintaining   600 m   may  trigger

       GPWS     caution  alerts.  Follow   the operational   advisory   “Reminder     on  GPWS
       Caution   Triggers  for RWY    34R  Approaches    at Pudong”   available  in EFB.


5.   Post-Landing        Ground      Operations      Phase


5.1.   Several   recent  incidents   occurred   at Stand   168:   due  to  uphill  gradient   and
       single-engine    taxi  condition,   aircraft could   not  move    even   with  maximum

       available  ground   thrust, requiring  engine  shutdown    and  tow-in   service. Control
       taxi speed  when   docking  at stands  with  such  gradients.
5.2.   Per  Pudong   Aerodrome    Instructions  AD2.20,    3.2.4: “Upon   sighting  marshalling

       vehicle,  arriving  crews  shall  switch  off  taxi lights and  follow   the marshalling
       vehicle”.

5.3.   When    taxiing towards   stands  equipped    with  Visual  Docking    Guidance   System
       (VDGS):    stop  taxi  immediately    if receiving   ambiguous    guidance    indications.
       When    entering  stands with  manual   marshalling,   stop  taxi if ground  marshalling

       personnel   are  not  on-site  (frequently   encountered    after  ad-hoc   stand   change

       post-landing).    Notify  ATC    promptly,   keep  engines   running   and   await  further
       instructions.


6.   Operating       Characteristics       in  Specific    Environments


6.1.   Low-visibility    and  low-ceiling    conditions   prevail  frequently   in winter.  Make
       adequate   preparations   accordingly.
6.2.   Bird-scare   cannon   blasts are loud  at Pudong.   Crews   shall avoid  undesired   startle

       response.


7.   Others


7.1      Ground/Apron       and   dispatch   frequencies:    Field  frequency     130.5 MHz     or
129.8 MHz;     Spring  Airlines  dispatch  frequency   130.5 MHz.

7.2  After   returning   to  Pudong     prior  to  an  onward     international   flight, manual
immigration     clearance   is recommended      for  the  first entry. Self-service    kiosks  are
system-restricted     to  one   passage   per   calendar   day.   Crews    may   get  trapped    at
self-service   channels  and  require  staff assistance  for fallback to manual   clearance.

7.3  Historical  Safety  Occurrences    (1)  Low-altitude    bird strike incidents   have  caused
excessive   radome   damage.   (2) Flight-plan  data-entry   errors occurred   following  runway
re-assignment.

candidates.text: Apron control may issue push-back and start-up clearance, or instruction to report push-back complete. Flight crews shall identify and comply with relevant clearances.
Closure of Taxiway E and Taxiway T1 is NOT published in NOTAMs. Refer to construction area chart (2C-1-SUP).

Frequent frequency changes occur during surface movement. Frequency change points are geographically close to taxi holding positions. Exercise vigilance to prevent taxi routing errors or overshooting holding lines.

Departure procedure may be amended while taxiing. Upon departure-mode revision, execute SOP for departure change, update flight plan, conduct supplementary briefing and apply departure-change checklist to avoid track deviation.
Automatic frequency hand-off upon lift-off atPudong. Handoff frequency shall be in accordance with PDC or ATC departure clearance.
For BK arrival:during north-bound operations, RWY 35L (western runway) is normally assigned; during south-bound operations, RWY 16L (eastern runway) is normally assigned.
Multiple arrival procedures are in use, with ad-hoc amendments possible. Direct-to clearances are common during off-peak periods. Maintain contingency plans.
Multiple TA/RA alerts have been recorded during south-bound approaches into Pudong. Prepare contingency measures during approach preparation and execute memory-item procedures per aircraft manual.

For RWY 17R / 35L, ATC may assign short base-leg vectors or issue ILS clearance at a late stage. Anticipate such scenarios, conduct proactive energy management, maintain active communication and accept ATC radar vectors as required. When performing “glideslope capture from above” procedure, strictly comply with SOP. If stable-approach criteriacannot be satisfied, execute missed approach or discontinued approach without hesitation.

For RWY 34R approach, tall obstacles exist slightly right-of-track between waypoints PD083 and PD084. Over-flying ator maintaining 600 m may trigger GPWS caution alerts. Follow the operational advisory “Reminder on GPWS Caution Triggers for RWY 34R Approaches at Pudong” available in EFB.

Several recent incidents occurred at Stand 168: due to uphill gradient and single-engine taxi condition, aircraft could not move even with maximum available ground thrust, requiring engine shutdown and tow-in service. Control taxi speed when docking at stands with such gradients.
Per Pudong Aerodrome Instructions AD2.20, 3.2.4: “Upon sighting marshalling vehicle, arriving crews shall switch off taxi lights and follow the marshalling vehicle”.

When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.
Low-visibility and low-ceiling conditions prevail frequently in winter. Make adequate preparations accordingly.
Bird-scare cannon blasts are loud at Pudong. Crews shall avoid undesired startle response.
Low-altitude bird strike incidents have caused excessive radome damage.
Flight-plan data-entry errors occurred following runway re-assignment.

Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

page_review.review_method: Physical PDF pages rendered with pdftoppm and read alongside complete plain/layout extraction; candidates alone were not used as proof of absence.

parser_bug_items.issue: Source item was token-trimmed before Chinese clause splitting, discarding tokenless continuation sentences.
examples: VTBS NAV fault operational caution, p317/p1166

parser_bug_items.issue: One remaining English sentence was always assigned to the first Chinese clause even when that clause was missing in the English source.
examples: VTBS STAR clause incorrectly received the following pavement/towing English clause, p315/p1163-1164

parser_bug_items.issue: Greedy exact-token skipping could borrow a later source item with a common token; alignment now requires an unambiguous globally monotonic assignment.
Joined annunciation words in extracted Chinese text produced false NAV/GPS token differences, although the rendered Chinese page has the same spaced words as English.
Runway pair ends, reverse runway labels, short taxiway identifiers, attached UTC and explicit bilingual acronym expansions were not extracted consistently.
Wind shear with a space was not recognized as windshear; turbulence remains a non-equivalent concept.
Current-manual source provenance was populated from old static airport page ranges (e.g. ZSPD 448-451 instead of current 584-587). Dynamic chapter page metadata now comes from the actual PDF headers.
Equivalent arrival/approach/landing headings and decimal list numbering without terminal dots needed structural coverage.
